name: update
description: Overwrite cells starting at range. Check what is there with read first, and confirm with the user before overwriting data they entered.

spreadsheet.description: Spreadsheet id, or its docs.google.com/spreadsheets URL. A URL with #gid= picks that tab.

sheet.description: Tab name. Default: the tab in the URL, else the first tab.

range.description: Where to write in A1 notation, e.g. B5 or A2:C4. The rows fill from its top-left cell.

rows.description: Rows to write. Each row is a list of cell values in column order, or an object keyed by the tab's header row (row 1) names, e.g. {"Date": "2026-10-19", "Amount": 12.5}.

input.description: user_entered (default) parses values as if typed: numbers, dates and formulas starting with =. raw stores them as text.
